Only download documents matching specified MIME types (PDF only, not DOCX)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import scrape, create_engine, CrawlConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        document_mime_types=["application/pdf"],
        download_documents=True,
        respect_robots_txt=False,
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await scrape(engine, url)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
